assumptions.mean_trade_shares: 10000 shares per market order — the one calibration input not measurable from the NGXDash cache (daily deal counts are not stored); order-of-magnitude checked against published NGX deal counts.
assumptions.tick_size: flat 0.01 NGN tick for all symbols (NGX's banded tick rules are not modeled)

provenance.sigma: ngxdash.analytics.volatility.realized_volatility(close, window=63, periods_per_year=252), last value, de-annualized by 1/sqrt(252)
provenance.arrival_rate: mean of cached daily `volume` over lookback / ASSUMED_MEAN_TRADE_SHARES / SESSION_SECONDS (deal counts are NOT in the cache; see assumptions)
